entry.name: WILDBRIDGE_STATUS_FLAG_MANUAL_OVERRIDE
entry.description: The pilot has taken the sticks and autonomous commands are being refused. Distinct from simply not being in a guided mode: it means a command was interrupted, which the heartbeat's mode flags cannot express.

entry.name: WILDBRIDGE_STATUS_FLAG_READY_TO_TAKEOFF
entry.description: Pre-flight checks pass and a takeoff command would be accepted.

entry.name: WILDBRIDGE_STATUS_FLAG_HOME_SET
entry.description: The aircraft has recorded a home point.

entry.name: WILDBRIDGE_STATUS_FLAG_LRF_TARGET_VALID
entry.description: The rangefinder target fields hold a real geo-referenced point.

entry.name: WILDBRIDGE_STATUS_FLAG_WAYPOINT_REACHED
entry.description: The aircraft is at the waypoint identified by waypoint_seq. Reported as state rather than only as a command acknowledgement, so a ground station that missed the ack can still see where things stand.

entry.name: WILDBRIDGE_STATUS_FLAG_YAW_REACHED
entry.description: The aircraft is on the heading identified by yaw_seq.

entry.name: WILDBRIDGE_STATUS_FLAG_ALTITUDE_REACHED
entry.description: The aircraft is at the altitude identified by altitude_seq.

enum.name: WILDBRIDGE_USER_1_SELECTOR
enum.description: param1 selector on MAV_CMD_USER_1 (31010). WildBridge uses the standard user-command range for payload operations that have no named MAV_CMD, keeping this dialect's own command ids free; the selector tells the aircraft which operation is meant. A ground station that does not know WildBridge still sees a well-formed user command.

entry.name: WILDBRIDGE_USER_1_GIMBAL_RELATIVE
entry.description: Nudge the gimbal by a delta: param2 pitch, param3 yaw (degrees).

entry.name: WILDBRIDGE_USER_1_RELEASE_MANUAL_OVERRIDE
entry.description: Release the RC manual-override latch and resume autonomous control.

entry.name: WILDBRIDGE_USER_1_RELEASE_SAFETY
entry.description: Return command authority to the Pilot. Only a frame signed with the Safety Computer's key is honoured; the Pilot cannot release safety. MAVLink counterpart of HTTP /releaseSafetyControl.

enum.name: WILDBRIDGE_USER_2_SELECTOR
enum.description: param1 selector on MAV_CMD_USER_2 (31011). Payload sensing operations, for the same reason as WILDBRIDGE_USER_1_SELECTOR.

entry.name: WILDBRIDGE_USER_2_LRF_MEASURE
entry.description: Fire the laser rangefinder once; the reading surfaces on the telemetry stream.

entry.name: WILDBRIDGE_USER_2_CAPTURE_TEMPERATURE
entry.description: Read the thermal spot temperature; result_param2 carries hundredths of a degree.

entry.name: WILDBRIDGE_USER_2_CAPTURE_THERMAL_IMAGE
entry.description: Trip one shutter on the thermal payload, storing thermal R-JPEG plus wide/zoom when enabled.

message.name: WILDBRIDGE_STATUS
message.description: WildBridge-specific aircraft state with no standard MAVLink equivalent. Streamed at a low rate alongside the standard telemetry.
message.field: Timestamp since system boot.
Rangefinder target latitude. Valid only with LRF_TARGET_VALID.
Rangefinder target longitude. Valid only with LRF_TARGET_VALID.
Rangefinder target altitude. Valid only with LRF_TARGET_VALID.
Furthest the aircraft may fly and still return on the remaining charge.
DJI's estimate of the time a return would take.
DJI's estimate of the time a landing would take.
Flight time on this battery.

Gimbal pitch relative to the aircraft, as DJI reports it. Carried rather than derived: composing the two attitudes MAVLink already sends recovers the right sign and slope but lands about 1.5 degrees out, because DJI's joint angles include a mounting offset that no amount of algebra can recover from the world attitude. Measured over 48 samples of a hand-tilted aircraft.
Gimbal roll relative to the aircraft.
Digital-zoom focal length, or 0 when unknown.
Optical focal length, or 0 when unknown.
Hybrid-zoom focal length, or 0 when unknown.
Charge a return is predicted to consume.
Charge a landing is predicted to consume.

Identifies the movement the altitude-reached flag refers to.
